title: Carroll Township to implement license plate reader system
summary: Carroll Township Police Department in York County, Pennsylvania, plans to implement a pole-mounted license plate reader system to aid in crime prevention, stolen vehicle recovery, and locating missing persons. Police emphasized that data is retained for one year, access is restricted to authorized personnel, and logins can be audited. The article also cites Newberry Township's chief touting a recent stolen motorcycle case solved with ALPR.

key_quotes.quote: The Carroll Township Police Department in York County is planning to implement a license plate reader system to enhance security and efficiency in the community.
only authorized personnel can view the license plate reader data, and all access is logged and can be audited. The data is stored for one year.
